source: 646 Indoor Fight
target: 646 Pugna Intra

source: Twanaku Tupián’s ears rang, his eyes stinging with blood.
target: Aures Twanaku Tupián resonaverunt, oculi eius sanguine pungebantur.

source: His mind burned, his thoughts scattering like sparks.
target: Mens eius ardebat, cogitationes eius quasi scintillae dispersae erant.

source: For an agonizing moment, he couldn’t process his situation, couldn’t even think about the enemy closing in.
target: Per momentum cruciæ, non potuit suam condicionem percipere, nec quidem de hoste appropinquantibus meditari.

source: Blood, smelling strangely metallic, trickled from his eyes and nose.
target: Sanguis, insolitam metallorum odorem habens, stillabat ex oculis et naso eius.

source: His pale skin darkened ominously.
target: Cutis eius pallida sinistrē obscurata est.

source: “Ha!”
target: “Ha!”

source: Lumian spat a blast of pale-yellow light, hitting the suspected Hisoka from barely two meters away.
target: Lumian evomuit fulgor lucis pallido-flavae, percutiens verisimilem Hisokam a paene duorum metrorum distantia.

source: Twanaku’s eyes slammed shut, and he collapsed.
target: Oculi Twanaku vehementer clausi sunt, et ille cecidit.

source: Before he hit the ground, Lumian’s Symphony of Hatred, a black bone flute, jabbed towards his neck.
target: Antequam in terram perveniret, Symphonia Odii Lumiani, fistula ossis nigrae, in collum eius incisit.

source: Instantly, the tiled bathroom floor dissolved into a vast, muddy expanse of darkness.
target: Statim, pavimentum balnei latericium in immensam, lutosam extensionem tenebrarum dissolutum est.

source: Arms burst upward.
target: Brachia sursum erupere coeperunt.

source: Some were stripped of skin, all raw muscle and glistening tendon.
target: Nonnulli sine cute erant, exhibentes solum musculum crudum et tendines nitidos.

source: Others twisted and ghostly, pale and transparent.
target: Alii, contorti et spectrales, pallidi et transparentes erant.

source: Some bore bulging eyes that spun madly, others sprouted thick green growths…
target: Nonnulli oculos prominentes, furibunde gyrantes, habebant; alii spessas virides protuberationes gerebant…

source: The grotesque limbs tore at Lumian and Twanaku, clawing and dragging.
target: Membra deformia Lumiani atque Twanaku laniabant, ungulis rapientibus et trahentibus.

source: This was Twanaku’s spell, a death-type enchantment once called Vengeful Wraith’s Entanglement, meant to summon an undead horde to paralyze his targets.
target: Hoc erat incantatio Twanaku, magia mortifera, quae olim “Vindicantis Umbrae Vinculum” appellata est, destinata ad evocandum multitudinem mortuorum ad metas paralysandas.

source: But as a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Devil pathway, his power twisted the spell into something new—the Fallen Abyss!
target: Sed ut Mid-Sequence Beyonder per semitam Diaboli, potentia eius incantationem in rem novam convertere fecit—Abyssus Ruinosus!

source: He could alter a space in advance, allowing undead or fallen creatures to lurk beneath the surface.
target: Potuit spatium praeconfigurare, sinens ut creaturae mortuorum aut lapsae sub superficie latitarent.

source: Anyone unfortunate enough to step inside would be grabbed by unseen arms and dragged into the muddy, pitch-black depths.
target: Quicumque casu intus ingrediatur, ab armis invisibilibus capietur et in lutum profundum ac atrum trahietur.

source: The Abyss would slow and weaken its victims, the icy touch of the undead stealing their strength with agonizing speed.
target: Abyssus victimis celeritatem retardaret atque robur eorum subripere solebat, tactus glacialis mortuorum vires eorum cum agonia rapiebat.

source: If they were pulled all the way under, they’d be corrupted and lost.
target: Si omnino sublacerentur, corrupti atque perditi erunt.

source: Twanaku had cast this spell in the bathroom before attacking Kolobo.
target: Twanaku hanc incantationem in balneo egerat, antequam Kolobo oppugnavit.

source: He hadn’t wanted any nosy employees or customers to stumble on the scene, but it turned out to be a lucky break.
target: Non voluerat aliquos operarios curiosos aut clientes in hanc scenam incidere, sed fortuito feliciter accidit.

source: That’s why he’d appeared in the mirror instead of right inside Kolobo’s eyes.
target: Ideo in speculo apparuit, potius quam recte in oculis Kolobo.

source: Lumian’s attack with the Symphony of Hatred came to an abrupt halt.
target: Impulsus Lumiani cum Symphonia Odii subito cessavit.

source: Countless arms wrapped around his ankles, calves, hips, and torso.
target: Innumerabiles brachia circa talos, crura, coxas, et trunco eius involuti sunt.

source: A wave of icy stiffness washed over him, his movements turning sluggish.
target: Unda glacialis rigoris eum pervagata est, et motus eius tardos facti sunt.

source: It was the same for Twanaku.
target: Idem Twanaku evenit.

source: With the Wraith and Desire Apostle unconscious, the Fallen Abyss slipped from his control, leaving him vulnerable.
target: Cum Wraith et Desire Apostle insensati erant, Abyssus Ruinosus ex eius potestate lapsus est, reliquens eum vulnerabilem.

source: His limp body was seized by the strange arms and dragged to the ground.
target: Corpus eius languidum ab insolitis brachiis captum est et ad terram trahitum est.

source: Nearby, Kolobo, badly injured and out for the count, was pulled into the muddy, pitch-black depths of the illusory Abyss.
target: Prope, Kolobo, graviter vulneratus atque exanimatus, in profundum lutosum atque atrum Abyssum illusorium trahiturus est.

source: A burst of crimson flames exploded from Lumian’s body, surrounding him like a blazing cloak.
target: Exruptio flammarum rubrarum ex corpore Lumiani erupit, circumducens eum ut pallium ardens.

source: The flames roared, scorching most of the arms into retreat.
target: Flammae rugiebant, et pleraque brachia in retrorsum comburiebant.

source: Still, some remained unaffected, their grip relentless.
target: Tamen, quidam intacti remanebant, eorum prehensio inexorabilis erat.

source: A creeping coldness numbed Lumian’s body, but he regained a sliver of his former agility.
target: Frigus insidiosum corpus Lumiani exsensivit, sed aliquam partem pristinae agilitas recuperavit.

source: Before, he could have simply lunged forward, thrusting the black bone flute towards his enemy’s neck.
target: Ante, facile potuisset praecurrere, fistulam ossium nigrorum in collum hostis feriens.

source: But now, the target—the one he believed was Hisoka—was about to vanish into the ground.
target: Sed nunc, meta, quem credebat esse Hisoka, mox in terram evanescere parabat.

source: Thud!
target: Tum!

source: Twanaku slammed into the ground, the impact jarring him awake.
target: Twanaku in terram conruperit, cui ictus eum excitavit.

source: The Spell of Harrumph’s grip faded, and he finally regained his senses.
target: Vinculum Incantationis Harrumph evanuit, et tandem sensus suos recuperavit.

source: His toughest moment, that relentless surge of desire, was behind him.
target: Difficillimum eius momentum, illud inexorabile desiderii impetum, iam praetererat.

source: Lumian lowered his head, a single scornful sound escaping him.
target: Lumian caput inclinavit, et unus solus sonus contemptus ex ore eius effugit.

source: “Hmph!”
target: “Hmph!”

source: Twin beams of white light shot out while Lumian retracted his hands, fingers slipping back into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Geminae radii lucis albae exsiluere, dum Lumian manus retraxit, digiti in Sacculum Viatoris reverterunt.

source: The beams missed their mark, but horrifying, bloody arms sprouted from the ground, a gruesome forest that blocked Twanaku from their path.
target: Radia meta suum non attingebant, sed horrenda sanguinolenta brachia ex terra erupere coeperunt, silva horrenda quae viam Twanaku clausit.

source: With a flash of awareness, Twanaku seized control of the Fallen Abyss spell, shielding himself and attacking his enemy.
target: Sub fulgore conscientiae, Twanaku incantationem Abyssus Ruinosus ceperat, se protegens atque hostem oppugnans.

source: The arms hit by the Spell of Harrumph softened, sinking back into the pitch-black mud as if drained.
target: Brachia, incantatione Harrumph percussa, mollita sunt, in lutum atrum recedentes, quasi exhaurita.

source: Twanaku took his chance.
target: Twanaku opportunitatem cepit.

source: His body twisted, morphing into a dark, oozing malevolence, a shape born from the darkest shadows of his heart.
target: Corpus eius contortum est, transformans se in obscuram, exsudentem malignitatem, figuram ex obscurissimis umbris cordis ornatam.

source: Silently, Twanaku transformed into an illusory, viscous, and foul black liquid, merging with the muddy Abyss and vanishing.
target: Tacite, Twanaku in liquorem nigrum, viscosum et immundum se transformavit, cum lutulento Abysso fusus atque evanuit.

source: The evil arms, unfazed by the flames, clung to Lumian, limiting his movement.
target: Membra nefaria, flammarum non perturbata, Lumiani adhaerebant, motum eius restringentes.

source: His hands flew to his Traveler’s Bag, pulling out a suit of gleaming silver armor.
target: Manus eius ad Sacculum Viatoris volaverunt, extrahentes loricam argenteam nitidam.

source: He set the armor beside him, sinking it firmly into the pitch-black mud.
target: Loricam iuxta se posuit, eam in lutum atrum firmiter submersit.

source: Pride Armor!
target: Lorica Superbia!

source: Evil, writhing arms erupted from the illusory Abyss—and the corresponding spirit world.
target: Membra nefaria, contortae, ex Abysso illusorio erupere coeperunt—et ex mundo spirituum congruentes.

source: Guided by the spell, they lunged for the Pride Armor, seizing its ankles, legs, torso, and back.
target: Incantatione ducti, in Loricam Superbiae impetum ceperunt, capientes eius talos, crura, truncum et dorsum.

source: The Pride Armor struck back, a broadsword of pure light flashing in its hand.
target: Lorica Superbia repulit, gladio lato purae lucis in manu eius micante.

source: Blinding, holy light flooded the washroom.
target: Lux caeca et sacra balneum inundavit.

source: The shadowy arms recoiled with hisses of black smoke, retreating into the depths.
target: Brachia umbratilia, sibilo fumi nigri, retrorsum in profunditates recederunt.

source: The pitch‑black mud dissolved, revealing the bathroom’s stone tiles.
target: Lutum atrum dissolutum est, et tegulae lapideae balnei apparuerunt.

source: Kolobo, who’d been on the brink of sinking into the Abyss, lay unconscious on the floor.
target: Kolobo, qui ad Abyssum labens versabatur, in pavimento incoscienter iacebat.

source: Just meters away, near the washroom door, a figure of viscous black liquid prepared to flee.
target: Paucis metris abhinc, prope ianuam balnei, figura liquoris nigri viscosi ad fugam praeparata erat.

source: Now free, Twanaku came to a swift decision.
target: Nunc liber, Twanaku celeriter consilium cepit.

source: He wouldn’t waste time trying to possess Lumian Lee.
target: Non tempus consumeret conatu Lumian Lee possidendi.

source: Instead, he’d abandon the Matani Import and Export Shop—and Port Pylos!
target: Pro eo, desereret Tabernam Matani Import et Export—atque Portum Pylos!

source: It was a trap.
target: Erat insidiae.

source: He had to escape before it closed around him.
target: Oportuit ei effugere, priusquam insidiae circa eum clauderentur.

source: Staying to fight back was foolish—he couldn’t risk lingering just to satisfy his rage and murderous desire.
target: Manere ad repugnandum stultum erat—non poterat periculum subire manendi solum ut iram et homicidam cupiditatem expleret.

source: That would be far too dangerous!
target: Id esset nimis periculosum!

source: Twanaku was glad he’d chosen to give Lumian Lee those two “gifts”.
target: Twanaku laetabatur quod illa duo “dona” Lumian Lee dare selegerat.

source: He’d even divided his favorite mystical items to do it.
target: Diviserat etiam res mysticas suas dilectissimas ad hoc faciendum.

source: The patrol team should be in chaos by now, focused on a false target.
target: Turma speculatorum iam in chao esse debet, falso obiecto intenti.

source: The distraction would give him his chance to escape.
target: Distractio ei occasionem ad effugiendum dabit.

source: Before, Twanaku hadn’t been focused on killing Camus.
target: Ante, Twanaku in caedem Camus non versabatur.

source: His priority was taking out Kolobo and escaping.
target: Propositum eius praecipuum erat Kolobo perimere et effugere.

source: If everything went smoothly, there shouldn’t be problems for either side.
target: Si omnia leniter evenissent, nullo utriusque partis problema exsisteret.

source: Any chaos caused by Camus’s death would be a bonus—
target: Omnis chaos ex morte Camus ortus bonus esset—

source: distracting the enemy by having the other passing off as the real deal.
target: hostem distrahens, habens alterum quasi verum simulatum.

source: He’d sent that extra “gift” as a precaution, not some bloodthirsty urge!
target: Illud extra “donum” misit ut cautio, non propter sanguinolentum impetum!

source: In Camus’s office, nestled inside the patrol team’s beige four‑story building, a poker card shimmered with metallic light as it hurtled towards him.
target: In officio Camus, intra aedificium speculatorum quattuor tabulorum colore beige, charta poqueri metallico lumine micans in eum appropinquabat.

source: Coffee was the last thing on his mind.
target: Coffea ultima re in mente eius erat.

source: He dove behind his desk with a surge of adrenaline, planning to send the table flying back at Sow before blasting him with Psychic Piercing.
target: Sub mensa sua se demisit, impulsu adrenalinæ affectus, consilium capiens mensam in Sow redire mittere antequam eum “Psychica Percussione” percuteret.

source: The joker‑faced card soared over Camus’s head, missing its target.
target: Charta, vultu iocoso, super caput Camus volavit, metam suam non attingens.

source: But then, as if it had a mind of its own, the card swerved and plunged down, aiming for Camus’s back.
target: Sed tunc, quasi animum proprium haberet, charta flectens declinavit et deiecit, ad dorsum Camus tendens.

source: It seemed to melt right into him, vanishing in a flash.
target: Videbatur in eum dissolvi, in ictu evanescens.

source: Sow’s grin stretched wider.
target: Rictus Sow latius se effundit.

source: He strode to the desk, yanking the broadsword from his back.
target: Incedens ad mensam, gladium latum ex dorso suo extrahens.

source: Inside the men’s bathroom of the Matani Import and Export Shop.
target: Intra balneum virorum Tabernae Matani Import et Export.

source: A figure made of thick, black liquid slipped through the crack under the door then strangely reformed in its original spot.
target: Figura ex liquore denso, nigro, per fissuram sub ianua lapsa est, deinde mirabili modo in loco originali reformata est.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Ampulla Fictiōnis!

source: The moment Lumian harbored malice and took out the Symphony of Hatred from the Traveler’s Bag, Lumian had used this bathroom vent as a base, using the Bottle of Fiction to set one condition: only females could enter or exit!
target: Mumento quo Lumian malitiam aluit et Symphonia Odii ex Sacculo Viatoris extraxit, hoc foramine balnei ut fundamentum usus est, Ampulla Fictiōnis ad conditionem unam statuendam: solae feminae introitum aut exitum facere poterant!

source: That way, innocent customers wouldn’t stumble into the dangerous Beyonder battle.
target: Ita, clientes innocentes in periculosam pugnam Beyonder non inciderent.

source: And Hisoka couldn’t escape without destroying the Bottle of Fiction first!
target: Et Hisoka non potuit effugere, nisi prius Ampullam Fictiōnis destruxerit!

source: The black, liquid figure spread toward the vent, dodging the two white beams from Lumian.
target: Figura liquida nigra ad foramine diffusa est, duas radii albae a Lumiano eludens.

source: Twanaku was done with dodging.
target: Twanaku eludere iam destitit.

source: His body swelled and warped, transforming into a monstrous giant almost three meters tall.
target: Corpus eius tumuit et contortum est, in ingentem monstrum fere trium metrorum altitudinis se transformans.

source: The monster’s skin turned a dull, dark shade, and a pair of curved goat horns marked with strange patterns sprouted from his head.
target: Cutis monstri in obscurum et opacum colorem versa est, et par cornua caprina curvata, insignita figuris miris, ex capite eius orta sunt.

source: Colossal bat wings wreathed in blue and crimson flames lashed out, releasing a stinging, sulfurous stench.
target: Alae vespertilionis colossales, involutae in flammarum caerulearum et rubrarum, se protraxerunt, odorem pungentem et sulphureum emittens.

source: Devil Transformation!
target: Transformatio Diaboli!

source: This was the signature power of a Sequence 6 Devil from the Prisoner pathway—a boost to strength, speed, defense… everything.
target: Hoc erat potentia insignis Diaboli, Sequenciae VI, ex via Captivi—a incrementum ad fortitudinem, celeritatem, defensionem… omnia.

source: Lumian knew his target, the one he thought was Hisoka, was on high alert, braced to dodge his Spell of Harrumph.
target: Lumian sciebat metam suam, illum quem putabat esse Hisoka, in alta vigilantia versari et paratum ad incantationem Harrumph eludendum esse.

source: He stopped using it.
target: Desiit illud uti.

source: He decided against the Symphony of Hatred too.
target: Decidit etiam non uti Symphonia Odii.

source: The situation was different.
target: Res diversa erat.

source: Before, his enemy had been fueled by bloodlust in his murder attempt on Kolobo, a perfect trigger.
target: Ante, hostis eius, sanguine cupidus, in conatu caedendi Kolobo inflammatus erat, perfectum incitamentum habens.

source: Now, there was only a cold, emotionless focus.
target: Nunc tantum erat frigida, animi carens intentio.

source: With no guarantee that the Symphony of Hatred would work —
target: Nullo certo spatio quod Symphonia Odii operaretur—

source: or that it wouldn’t backfire—Lumian wasn’t taking that chance.
target: aut quod contrarium non eveniret—Lumian non illam fortunam arripiebat.

source: Instead, a crimson spear sparked into existence.
target: Pro eo, hasta coccinea subito apparuit.

source: From a few meters away, he hurled it at the suspected Hisoka.
target: Ex paucis metris distantia, eam in suspectum Hisoka iaculatus est.

source: The second the spear left his hand, Lumian vanished.
target: Secundo quo hasta manum eius reliquit, Lumian evanuit.

source: He couldn’t stay put.
target: Non potuit manere hic.

source: Possession by the Wraith, a mind‑shattering psychic blast from a Desire Apostle, some twisted desire spell—any of those were a risk!
target: Possessio a Wraith, ictus psychicus mentem confractans ab Apostolo Desiderii, et aliqua incantatio perversi desiderii—quaeque ex his pericula erant!
